hypotheses.statement: L1 behavioural fidelity (l1_pos_hit / l1_hard_er) is the strongest single predictor of Stage3 Recall@10.
hypotheses.verdict_reason: SID-group OOF (n=129): prior l1_pos_hit rho -0.283, train-selected best single rho -0.149; the single-feature ranking from #275 does not generalise across SID groups

hypotheses.statement: Capacity (l2_distinct, l3_collision, l3_refine_bits) adds beyond fidelity.
hypotheses.reopen_reason: descriptive rho l3_collision +0.483 / l2_distinct -0.391; no fold-level ablation
hypotheses.verdict_reason: identical frozen folds: fidelity-only ridge 0.003507/0.473 vs six-feature 0.003221/0.512 (exploratory alpha=10)

hypotheses.statement: Vector distortion (quant_error, effective_rank) adds beyond SID features.
hypotheses.reopen_reason: CI covered zero on the family-LOFO design; issue #276 reopens it under SID-group CV because the grouping unit changed (new evidence path: results/research/issue276/) and the Q_VEC band lacked positives
hypotheses.verdict_reason: Q_VEC (n=73): ridge13 rho 0.699 vs ridge6 0.552 but MAE 0.005696 vs 0.003423; PySR increment CI [-0.00031,+0.00169] covers zero; ranking up, calibration down

hypotheses.statement: Curvature/distance geometry adds beyond SID features.
No feature set beats the fold mean/median out of fold; fits are family confounding.
hypotheses.verdict_reason: ridge6 MAE 0.003059 vs fold median 0.004424 (31% lower), rho 0.616

hypotheses.statement: #275's negative is an artifact of family-LOFO with degenerate controls and zero positives; SID-identity grouping changes the ordering of ridge vs PySR.
hypotheses.verdict_reason: under SID grouping with 13 positives PySR is still significantly worse than ridge6 (CI [+0.00049,+0.00154]); the #275 PySR-vs-linear ordering is not a family-grouping artifact

hypotheses.statement: The recon-vs-recall relation (rho -0.858) survives protocol slicing and holds inside the high-recall band.
hypotheses.verdict_reason: unified decoder MSE (bias-included forward, n=73) rho -0.087; high band +0.287 (n=12); #275 used final-epoch batch loss and a bias-less forward on n=23

hypotheses.statement: High-recall historical SIDs (recall > 0.06) are recoverable and bindable to their Stage3 records by content evidence.
hypotheses.verdict_reason: 12/12 named high-recall arms content-bound (6 L1 ledger, 6 L2 collision); 91 records >0.06, 26 with a bound arm

hypotheses.statement: Effective rank has a moderate window (non-monotone relation to recall) that a linear model cannot capture.
hypotheses.verdict_reason: PR(z) bins: 0.0463/<4, 0.0549/4-6, 0.0595/6-8, 0.0548/8-12, 0.0529/>=12; overall rho -0.031 -> window shape without a monotone relation

hypotheses.statement: The 13/13 >0.06 identification survives an independent recomputation from the Ridge6 predictions and a strict identity split.
hypotheses.verdict_reason: recomputed 13/13 tp 0 fp; strict core 6/6 tp 0 fp; 7 positives rest on weak identity

hypotheses.statement: The inner-fold StandardScaler leak inflates the #276 ridge result.
hypotheses.verdict_reason: corrected scaler-inside-inner-fold OOF 0.002972/0.667 vs leaky 0.003031/0.623; no inflation

hypotheses.statement: The frozen predictor's prospective prediction for TIGER_pairrank_enc_rq (0.05319) is below the 0.06 threshold once its Stage3 label lands.
